hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let v be list at (the register's 'currBpIdx').
Queue the move {abilityTag: "magitek_barrier"}.
Let list2 be [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: v's 'paramSuffixNoInvincible'}, {builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_ALL status}, {builtin: "RESET"}, {messageSuffixNo: "01"}].
If v's 'useWaveCannon', then
  Let v2 be data2 at (the numeric entry v's 'turnsToUseWaveCannonAiArg' in aiArg).
  If v2 is set, then append {messageSuffixNo: v2} to list2.
Queue the pose-change sequence [list2].
Put queued moves ahead of counters.
Run helper2.
If v's 'useWaveCannon', then run helper3.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let v be list at (the register's 'currBpIdx').
Let list2 be [].
Append {abilityId: arg} to list2.
If v's 'useWaveCannon', then
  Let v2 be unset.
  Set v2 to if the register's 'remainingTurnsToUseWaveCannon' is at most 0 then data2 at (the numeric entry v's 'turnsToUseWaveCannonAiArg' in aiArg) else data2 at (the register's 'remainingTurnsToUseWaveCannon').
  If v2 is set, then append {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: v2}]]}} to list2.
The enemy uses arg with its cast time and then list2.

script_hooks.logic:
Run helper4.
If condition flag "lightning_attack" is up this frame, then
  Decrease the register's 'remainingAttacksToRemoveMagitekBarrier' by one.
  Let v be data at (the register's 'remainingAttacksToRemoveMagitekBarrier').
  If v is set, then the enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: v}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If the register's 'remainingAttacksToRemoveMagitekBarrier' is at most 0, then choose state 15 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v2 be run helper5.
  Run helper6 on v2.
